title: Attribution had no AI-answer channel: a visit sent by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini or Copilot was counted as search or organic

source.ref: found 2026-10-05 by the scan-seven SEO/GEO finders (26-agent fan-out), confirmed by hand against the tree

detail: FOUND 2026-10-05 (scan seven, geo-ai finder). robots.ts calls AI citation a primary acquisition channel and welcomes nine AI crawlers by name, and lib/attribution/channels.ts could not see one: gemini.google.com and copilot.microsoft.com matched the search hosts, chatgpt.com, perplexity.ai and claude.ai fell to 'organic', and utm_source=chatgpt.com (which ChatGPT appends to the links it cites) matched nothing. CLOSED 2026-10-05: 'ai_answer' joins ACQUISITION_CHANNELS and CHANNEL_LABEL, AI_HOSTS is checked before the search hosts, the UTM sources map, and the governed registry carries source_ai_answer; channels.test.ts pins the hosts, the UTM source and that plain Google search is still search. No database constraint lists channels, so no migration.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const c=fs.readFileSync("lib/attribution/channels.ts","utf8");const r=fs.readFileSync("lib/traits/registry.ts","utf8");if(!/\x27ai_answer\x27,/.test(c)||!/hostMatches\(host, AI_HOSTS\)\) return \x27ai_answer\x27/.test(c)||!/key: \x27source_ai_answer\x27/.test(r)){console.error("SCAN-671: attribution has no AI-answer channel, so a visit sent by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini or Copilot is counted as search or organic and the channel robots.ts calls primary cannot be measured.");process.exit(1)}'
verify.note: Fails on main before this change; passes with it.
